### setItem(keyName, keyValue)

Source: https://github.com/mdn/content/blob/main/files/en-us/web/api/storage/setitem/index.md

Sets or updates a key-value pair in the storage object. Storage only natively supports strings, so complex data types must be serialized (e.g., with JSON.stringify()). Throws QuotaExceededError if storage limits are exceeded.

```APIDOC
## setItem(keyName, keyValue)

### Description
Adds a key to the given `Storage` object with the specified value, or updates the value if the key already exists.

### Syntax
```javascript
setItem(keyName, keyValue)
```

### Parameters
- **keyName** (string) - A string containing the name of the key you want to create or update.
- **keyValue** (string) - A string containing the value you want to give the key you are creating or updating.

### Return Value
- **undefined** - None.

### Exceptions
- **QuotaExceededError** - Thrown if the storage runs out of disk quota or the user declined to grant more space.

### Example
```javascript
function populateStorage() {
  localStorage.setItem("bgcolor", "red");
  localStorage.setItem("font", "Helvetica");
  localStorage.setItem("image", "myCat.png");
}

// Storing objects as strings
const person = { name: "Alex" };
localStorage.setItem("user", JSON.stringify(person));
```
```

### Storage: setItem() method

The **`setItem()`** method of the {{domxref("Storage")}} interface, when passed a key name and value, will add that key to the given `Storage` object, or update that key's value if it already exists.

### QuotaExceededError

Source: https://github.com/mdn/content/blob/main/files/en-us/web/api/quotaexceedederror/index.md

The **`QuotaExceededError`** interface represents an error when a requested operation would exceed a system-imposed storage quota.

> [!NOTE]
> In browser versions before this interface was implemented, it was a regular `DOMException`. The subclassing allows for extra information like `quota` and `requested` to be included.
